verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs say it connects through official drivers and APIs for multiple languages. They list DuckDB SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java, and MotherDuck ships its own Wasm Client library for browser apps. An OpenAPI spec is also published, so building against official SDKs is clearly supported. Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference depth beyond one-line mentions, clarity on which SDKs are MotherDuck-specific versus inherited DuckDB clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
